barks.text: Morning! Best part of the day.
Sun's going down. Time to head home soon.
Pikachu love this weather. I don't.

talk.text: Potions, snacks, gossip — I sell it all. Well, mostly gossip until my stock arrives.
Is that your partner? It looks strong! Potions, snacks, gossip — I sell it all. Well, mostly gossip until my stock arrives.
A Pokédex! Professor Oak must trust you.
